title: Cognitive Bias Signatures in Search-Equipped LLM Agents: A Stage-Resolved Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.05720v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Search can help LLM agents correct mistakes, but their starting conditions may shape which evidence they find and use. Drawing on cognitive-bias paradigms, we develop a controlled search harness to examine result order, records of prior work, and initial hypotheses while holding each question and document collection fixed. Matched controls distinguish order effects from differences in document composition and the effects of failed work from context length. Across 10 models and 1,000 synthetic search worlds, we track queries, retrieved documents, document openings, and final answers. Our comparisons suggest that final answers are more sensitive to initial evidence order during active search than when all evidence is supplied in full. Dead-end histories can reduce strategy switching relative to matched neutral histories, indicating an effect beyond context length. translated_title: 配备搜索的LLM智能体中的认知偏差特征：一种分阶段解析分析
translated_abstract: 搜索可以帮助LLM智能体纠正错误，但它们的起始条件可能会塑造它们找到并使用哪些证据。借鉴认知偏差范式，我们开发了一个受控搜索实验框架，在保持每个问题和文档集合固定不变的前提下，检验结果排序、先前工作记录和初始假设的影响。通过匹配对照实验，我们区分了排序效应与文档组成差异的影响，以及失败工作记录的影响与上下文长度的影响。我们在10个模型和1,000个合成搜索世界环境中，跟踪了查询、检索到的文档、文档打开情况以及最终答案。我们的对比结果表明，与所有证据被完整一次性提供的情况相比，最终答案在主动搜索过程中对初始证据顺序更为敏感。与匹配的中性历史记录相比，死胡同式的失败历史记录会减少策略切换，这表明其影响超出了上下文长度的范畴。在错误假设条件下，分阶段测量能够区分检索减少或……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过控制变量与匹配对照的分阶段实验，揭示了配备搜索功能的LLM智能体中存在类似人类的认知偏差特征——最终答案在主动搜索时对初始证据顺序更敏感，且死胡同式失败历史会抑制策略切换，这些效应无法用文档组成或上下文长度来解释。
en_tdlr: This stage-resolved analysis reveals human-like cognitive bias signatures in search-equipped LLM agents: final answers are more sensitive to initial evidence order during active search, and dead-end histories reduce strategy switching in ways that cannot be explained by document composition or context length alone.
